segments.en: Hello.
Where are you from?
I am from Trivandrum. Where are you?
This is Kollam.
Okay, what do you do?
I used to do work from home, but I am not doing anything now.
Okay, you are awake, right? You don't have sleep at night?
Morning, now it is... this I was yesterday morning... sorry, yesterday night I was awake.
Is that so?
What is the reason for not sleeping?
I need some money in the morning.
Is that so?
Yes.
Is there any work?
Yes, there is OpenTalk, it is on WhatsApp, it is a paid service.
Why is it like that?
From this, we get 5 rupees per minute. So, there is no need to do free work.
You are getting it, right?
If you are getting it, then it is your choice.
I just said, if I do it, I usually do it on WhatsApp. I have a safety issue because it is scary.
Okay.
Bye bye, look for something else.
